patch_list: Real black instead of dark grey in Splitwise's dark mode: backgrounds, screens, bottom sheets, the status and navigation bars and the group charts. Cards stay a shade lighter so they stand out. AMOLED screens switch black pixels off, which…

Treats the account as Pro and switches on the paid features: unlimited expense entries, search, charts, spreadsheet export, currency conversion, group totals history and stats, default splits, reminders, balance alerts, trip dates, larger…

Routes Google sign-in, Google Drive and Firebase push through MicroG-RE (GmsCore) instead of Google Play services. Signs the push registration with Splitwise's original certificate, so notifications still arrive on a re-signed build, and k…

Removes the full-screen ad after adding an expense, the ad in Activity, the Pro diamond, the Pro account and Pro Duo cards, the Pro Pass prompts, the Pro tour screen, the hiring promo and the rate-the-app prompt.
Turns off Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics and the advertising-ID collection the app declares in its manifest.
